result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but the horizontally scrolling restaurant cards in the 'Fastest near you' section are clipped at the right edge without any visual affordance (e.g., fade or partial card peek is present but 'Trattoria Piccol...' text is cut off mid-word), which can look broken. Other elements render correctly.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off mid-word at the right screen edge, and its delivery fee line is also truncated, giving a slightly broken appearance.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll containers show a clear partial-card peek with consistent padding, or add a right-edge fade/scroll indicator so truncation reads as intentional scrollable content rather than a layout break.

issues.description: The notification bell icon in the top-right relies only on a small red dot to convey unread status, with no text label or badge count.
issues.suggestion: Add an accessible label (e.g., aria-label='Notifications, 1 unread') and consider a count badge so the status is perceivable to screen-reader and low-vision users.
